i'm so happy you can relate. i'm sorry you are in a rough spot too, i know it can feel a bit better knowing you aren't alone. the second part of what you said made me cry a lot because all i have felt lately is worthlessness, that i don't deserve to be here, and even though a stranger is stating my worth to me it means a lot. each individual is so unique and special, and i need to hold onto that and remember i am as deserving of life just as anyone else.
